# `github.com/grow-codes-packages/openobserve/go` — agent quickstart (Go)

Ships in the module root (`go env GOMODCACHE`/github.com/grow-codes-packages/openobserve/go@vX/AGENTS.md). Use it
instead of reading the source. Docs: https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/openobserve/ · Service: OpenObserve ·
Categories: logging,tracing. Package name: `openobserve`. Needs Go >= 1.26 (`GOTOOLCHAIN=auto` on older images).

```sh
go get github.com/grow-codes-packages/openobserve/go@latest
```

## Client

```go
import openobserve "github.com/grow-codes-packages/openobserve/go"

client, err := openobserve.NewClientFromEnv() // GROW_OPENOBSERVE_* > vendor env > defaults
defer client.Close()
```

Errors are `*openobserve.Error` with `Code`; use `errors.Is(err, openobserve.ErrNotFound)` (`ErrConfig`, `ErrAuthentication`,
`ErrPermissionDenied`, `ErrConflict`, `ErrRateLimited`, `ErrValidation`, `ErrUnavailable`, `ErrTimeout`,
`ErrUnsupported`, `ErrCancelled`). Credentials are `Secret` (redacted in fmt/slog/JSON).

## Logging: one call

```go
logger, shutdown, err := openobserve.InitLogging(ctx, openobserve.InitOptions{Service: "orders"}) // after LoadConfig
defer shutdown(context.Background())
http.ListenAndServe(":8080", openobserve.RequestMiddleware(mux)) // X-Request-Id + "request completed"
logger.InfoContext(r.Context(), "created", "id", id)
```

- `InitLogging(ctx, InitOptions{Service, Level string; Stdout, DisableStdout, Ship, NoSetDefault bool; ...})
  (*slog.Logger, func(context.Context) error, error)`; installs `slog.Default`.
- Always JSON lines on stdout (`time`, `level`, `msg`, `service`, `environment`, `request_id`, `trace_id`,
  `span_id`, attributes, redacted). With `GROW_LOGGING_PROVIDER=openobserve` it also ships through this package
  (config from `GROW_OPENOBSERVE_*`), marks lines `log_shipped:"sdk"` and re-emits records the SDK could not
  export with `log_shipped:"sdk_failed"`. Never fails for a down logging service.
- `RequestMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler`, `WithRequestID(ctx, id)`, `RequestIDFrom(ctx)`,
  `SendCanary(ctx, message, attrs) bool` (SDK only), `LoggingClient()`; adapters `NewSlogHandler(client, opts)`,
  subpackage `zapadapter`.

## Tracing

The tracing entry point (`initTracing` / `InitTracing` / `init_tracing`) and its options are documented in the
package README and https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/openobserve/tracing/ (span helpers `withSpan`, `traced`,
`currentTraceId`, HTTP middleware).
